purpose: Preserve the material Calendar/Habits/Money product knowledge from a max-length chat without making future agents redesign settled behavior or depend on inaccessible chat history.

source_quality.rule: Use the pasted chat as rationale/evidence, Git for what was actually implemented, and current contracts for what must be preserved. Do not promote an old conversational proposal to Current merely because it appears in the transcript.

privacy.rule: Do not copy private calendar details, health-related appointment metadata, personal URLs, finance rows or other personal payloads into public coordination. Preserve their generic product behavior through contracts and leave personal values in their proper private/local owners.

git_reconciliation.action: work/calendar-life-preview fast-forwarded to the current main head; no unique branch work was discarded.

rules: Grid/time lines remain visually behind event blocks rather than cutting through them.
Event blocks keep real breathing room from grid boundaries.
Do not reintroduce the abandoned experimental left/right collision deformation merely to solve narrow overlap cases.
Responsive behavior follows the actual calendar container/embed width, not a device-name assumption.
The week retains all seven days.
On narrower widths, remove or simplify secondary detail before shrinking primary text into microtypography.
Do not preserve a hidden 1080px internal minimum that breaks split-screen layouts.
Wide/compact/narrow/phone modes are legitimate implementation tools but are subordinate to readable geometry.
Recurring personal events may have custom vector symbols.
Custom symbols are monochrome/theme-adaptive and responsive so they do not consume event text at narrow widths.
Product code should preserve recurring identity instead of manually cloning occurrence after occurrence.
Do not hard-code personal schedule or sensitive appointment details into public recovery metadata.
Canonical habit behavior history is IndexedDB behavior_events after verified migration.
Legacy localStorage history is frozen rollback evidence after cutover and must not silently become canonical again.
Habit taps remain local-first and do not require network access.
Every mutation is recoverable through the persistence outbox before asynchronous IndexedDB flush.
Trajectory/graph values stay derived and are never persisted as a second truth.
Any supported rendered event may own one user-defined destination.
The event body opens the link editor; only the universal chain symbol opens the destination.
The chain symbol has one meaning and one top-right position across event types.
Existing class editing and delete behavior must survive the link feature.
Event links belong inside canonical calendar state so normal backup/export preserves them.
Personal destinations are never hard-coded into public source.
Opening an event dialog must not cause the outer page to walk downward or grow indefinitely.
Dialog focus must not trigger outer automatic scrolling.
While a dialog is open, embedded calendar height is stabilized; after close, normal height fitting resumes.
Dialog internal scroll is contained and there is one effective outer vertical-scroll owner.

calendar: Seven-day week; current product week starts on Sunday.
Compressed whole-week free time is one passive full-width band, not many clickable cells.
No event card is visually crossed by grid lines.
No dynamic content becomes unreachable through hard-coded iframe height or clipping.
Responsive degradation removes secondary detail before sacrificing readable primary typography.
habits: Exactly fourteen equal visible day columns ending at HOY.
The whole label rail toggles that tracker's graph; the chevron is not an exclusive tiny target.
A geometric X means an undesired event only; never use X for positive completion.
Blank is baseline/no-negative-event for activated negative trackers and neutral/unmarked for positive Extras.
Each tracker graph is separate; graphs are not overlaid into one chart.
HOY never draws a vertical line through an opened trajectory plot.
Streak stats never sit beside the tracker name; secondary graph rail owns that information.
Category headers are full-width collapsible bands with only title + minimal chevron.
Trajectory is derived from behavior logs and changing scoring never rewrites history.
money: Money is a temporal monthly projection, not a generic six-month dashboard.
QUEDA PROYECTADO is primary; ENTRA/SALE are secondary.
Potential income remains visually and mathematically separate from confirmed projection.
Calendar consumes the Finance abstraction when real private Finance becomes available; it must never wire directly to Mercado Pago.
Private Finance runtime truth belongs to the finance-auth workstream, not to this recovery file.
visual_language: Use the active two-color theme literally.
Information is not automatically a button; tactile relief belongs to manipulable controls.
Do not solve responsive pressure by shrinking important text into unreadable microtypography.

negative_knowledge: Do not put streak/KPI clutter beside habit labels.
Do not make a tiny chevron the only graph hit target.
Do not use X for a good/positive event.
Do not run HOY vertically through trajectory charts.
Do not create multiple clickable TIEMPO LIBRE cells for one compressed span.
Do not hard-code large inner minimum widths that break split-screen.
Do not let dialogs alter iframe height recursively or scroll the outer page on focus.
Do not restore the legacy habit localStorage object as canonical after verified IndexedDB cutover.
Do not persist derived trajectory values as behavior truth.
Do not create a page-local microphone if Capture is needed; use the shared P4 owner.
Do not keep extending accumulated CSS/JS patch chains indefinitely without a controlled consolidation plan.

future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.note: Already named by the active Habits persistence contract; do not redesign from scratch.

future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.goal: Separate typed Calendar and Money migrations into local-first storage.
future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.note: Habits cutover exists; Calendar/Money must migrate separately and additively.

future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.goal: Consolidate accumulated CSS/JS patches into canonical current files while preserving contracts and rollback history.
future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.note: Do not delete historical evidence or perform a blind rewrite.

future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.goal: Automated functional + responsive visual regression gates before publication.
future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.note: Use existing contracts as assertions; include representative narrow/split/wide viewports.

future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.goal: Make the product self-describing enough that a fresh agent loads current implementation, contracts, negative knowledge, storage owner and tests before editing.
future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.note: Reuse Reincarnation/Current/Catalog/Lineage + Agent Runtime rather than creating a competing second current.json authority.

future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.goal: Optional cross-device sync after local ownership is stable.
future_direction_preserved_not_claimed_c.note: Network must remain optional for local habit interaction.

finance_boundary.rule: Any claim about real Finance/provider connection status must be refreshed from finance-auth/private runtime; do not freeze a provider status into Calendar recovery.

fresh_agent_instruction: Continue from current Git + these contracts. Do not ask for the inaccessible old chat, do not reconstruct the Calendar/Habits design from screenshots, and do not restart architectural planning that is already encoded here.
